name: takealot-mcp
description: Takealot Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing. Every too

platform_mcp_takealot_authorization.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TAKEALOT_AUTHORIZATION
platform_mcp_takealot_authorization.description: The complete Authorization header value for your Seller API key exactly as the Takealot Seller Portal shows it (Seller Portal > API, https://seller.takealot.com/api/seller-api — generate the key there; the public reference only says to 'attach an Authorization header' and defers the format to that page).

platform_mcp_takealot_merchant_warehouse.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TAKEALOT_MERCHANT_WAREHOUSE_ID
platform_mcp_takealot_merchant_warehouse.description: Your leadtime merchant_warehouse_id (listed at https://seller.takealot.com/api/seller-api/offers); required by set_inventory.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe returns the number of your offers ({count}) to verify the key.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PATCH /v2/offers/offer/{identifier} {selling_price} changes the LIVE selling price. `listing_id` is Takealot's Offer ID, or your SKU/barcode prefixed as SKU<sku> / BARCODE<barcode>; `price` must be a positive whole number of rand (decimals are rejected). Stock is set_inventory; titles are catalogue data. validation_errors in raw.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: PATCH /v2/offers/offer/SKU{sku} {leadtime_stock: [{merchant_warehouse_id, quantity}]} sets your LEADTIME (merchant-warehouse) stock for the offer with that SKU; stock already at Takealot DCs is not changed. Needs the merchant_warehouse_id config field.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: status_action Disable sets the offer to 'Disabled by Seller' (reversible with Re-enable). `listing_id` is the Offer ID or SKU<sku>.
